description:
Welcome to your perfect East Nashville getaway! This stunning, professionally designed townhome offers the ideal blend of modern comfort, style, and convenience, perfect for weekend trips, business travel, or extended stays.

The space
Our house is a 3 bed/3 bath home located in East Nashville. It is only 6 miles from Broadway!

All our beds:
1 King Bed
2 Queen Beds
1 Queen Air mattress to set up in the living room area. 

The house can accommodate 7-8 guests.

Guest access
You have access to the entire house. There is free parking for two small vehicles in the garage. Do not park in front of the garage or you will be towed/booted. There is also paid parking for excess/larger vehicles across from the unit next to the mailboxes, just be sure to scan the QR code on the sign to pay for parking in this area.
